The '''airborne infantry''' was a military division within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. The Republic's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] airborne [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] participated in the conflict's opening engagement; the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. There, a [[Seven-One's airborne group|group]] led by [[clone battalion commander]] [[CRC-09/571|Seven-One]] led a frontal assault against [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Core ship/Legends|core ships]].<ref name="Shatterpoint" />
